spec.name: Furniture Haunted Streetlamp
spec.description: Freestanding gothic iron streetlamp with a stepped stable foot, rear upright, suspended amber lantern and compact bat finial. Twenty-two connected, axis-aligned cuboids fit within one block horizontally and two vertically. Front faces negative Z. All parts have distinct, non-overlapping cube-net UVs.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: freestanding gothic black iron streetlamp with broad stable base, a hanging amber lantern and small bat finial contained inside its footprint. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..16, y=0..32, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
